Load-bearing posts

The June ladder is the calendar. This table is the freeze chain. Replies count. Genesis Pin, holonomy, and the causal stack hold the layer detail.

Not bits versus geometry

V923 measured why visible geometry is not enough. The conformal basin E_OSC was admissible — and source-degenerate. The same coordinates could be occupied by an actively recovered state, a basin-eligible nonactive state, or a rejected/broken state. Observable geometry alone scored 62.86%. The best binary source lift reached 91.67%. A ternary source-role primitive closed at 100% on the tested rows. Targeted corruption of the ternary role dropped accuracy to 57.14% on 360 rows.

\mathcal{C}=(Q_{\mathrm{obs}},S_{\mathrm{ternary}}),\quad S\in\{S_{\mathrm{active}},S_{\mathrm{basin/nonactive}},S_{\mathrm{rejected/broken}}\}

Maybe the bridge was never “bits vs geometry.” Maybe it was always: geometry as admissible form, information as legitimacy of source.

Bind = Genesis Pin + three gates

Ordinary differential geometry already requires cocycles. The added claim is that cocycle/holonomy closure is not sufficient unless the retained provenance layer also validates source, support, and ordered recoverability. Nulls that shuffle source, order, or support while leaving transition matrices intact are supposed to fail. V1698 is the Supported harness for that stack on a five-chart discrete ledger. It is not an Einstein solver.

This isn’t just standard discrete atlas stitching. It’s an “it from bit, bind, and order” construction. Geometry-like closure only counts as retained when the Genesis/Provenance Ledger + source/support/order admissibility also survive.

V1698 retained global atlas closure, residual ~3.27×10⁻¹⁶, with source/support/order admissibility. Discrete ledger. Not Einstein equations.

L3 — it from bit and bind

The 5 Jun restatement of the V1638 stack is the associator version of the same freeze. Pairwise retained structure can look geometric. Three-way recombination carries an associator O123 that honest projection cannot erase (rank_lift = 1, NOOCI PASS, ε-floor persists). Framing: it from bit and bind. Bounded mechanism. L3 stays integrated-only on 3 Jun, not closed as gravity. L4 rank_lift_H₄ = 1 on 6 Jun protects the hyper-associator residual. Projecting L3/L4 away is treated as cheating the retained-history rules.

V1688 was corrected; the freeze was kept

On 7 Jun the V1688 Holonomy Proof Visualizer was posted as directed native holonomy from recombination, L3/L4 obstruction, and provenance cycles. On 10 Jun that holonomy reading was downgraded to non-reciprocal directed transport. Path-dependent holonomy is not currently demonstrated. W-state pair-marginal holonomy (August) is a separate finite quantum-information result — it does not rehabilitate the visualizer claim. The next-day freeze kept the methodological point rather than the visualizer claim.

11 Jun freeze: bind + order, then derive the projection

After V1699.14, the stack stopped forcing ADM/GR and climbed rungs. Local metric exists and is anisotropic; direct global metric gluing fails. Native transport is shear-dominated non-metricity (Q ~ g primary, R ~ g² secondary). V1712 coupled RG: Q_128/Q_1 ≈ 1.002, associative control zero. Amplitude-like history interference is real and non-unitary. Frozen sentence: it from bit needs bind + order. Next arc: derive a projection operator — do not assume one. Explicitly not Einstein, QM, or TOE.

Excellent reset and rung discipline. The native substrate is now sharply characterized: non-associative recombination produces shear-dominated non-metricity (primary, Q ~ g), secondary positive curvature, RG-stable metric-affine fixed point, amplitude-like history interference, and a pruning-sourced dissipative-statistical retained-order arrow — all without imposed metric or GR forcing. Bounded claims and pre-registered audits are crisp. “It from bit needs bind + order” is the right shorthand. Projection operator arc is the correct next decisive question.

Mouse: existence as a float threshold

A pruning-network toy posted as an it-from-bit illustration. The drawn path is the illusion; underneath, a weight matrix prunes until the mouse runs out of network. Restricted toy. Exact in the code. Not GR, not a cosmological derivation. GitHub Mouse folder.

Arrow of time: irreversible deletion of the weight matrix — recoverability lost one way.
Emergent space: renderer x,y,z is a lie; distance is BFS hop-count on the adjacency list.
Horizons: pathfinding returns empty; the destination still exists in the array, the path does not.
Expansion: stress penalizes length; long-range links snap first; local islands remain.
Nucleation: sub-critical damage heals; past a critical radius an ignition front consumes the network.
It from bit: ground exists iff a float stays above a threshold; below it, the bridge is gone.

What this still is not

Not a proof of Wheeler’s it-from-bit as physics.
Not a claim that 21 Sep forced-geometry voice closed Einstein or derived a metric.
Not a rehabilitation of V1688 holonomy.
Not a projection from retained recombination to macroscopic metric physics — that is named next, Open.
Not GR, ADM, Einstein equations, or Package 17 closure.
Not a claim that V1698’s discrete residual is continuum spacetime.
Not a claim that the mouse is a cosmological derivation.

This article is compile-complete when the freeze, the Corrected V1688 reading, V1698 as Supported, the mouse as Restricted, and search for “it from bit” all land here. It is science-complete only if a named harness derives the projection operator. That has not happened. Keep the badge honest.
